'''Xenomedicine''' was the study and practice of medicine involving [[Alien/Legends|alien]] [[Species/Legends|species]]. The [[Journal of Xenomedicine]] was a notable publication on the subject of xenomedicine during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]].<ref name="Knocks">{{TORcite|type=conversation|Doc|Opportunity Knocks}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
Xenomedicine was first mentioned in the conversation "Opportunity Knocks" with [[Archiban Frodrick Kimble|Doc]], a companion character for the [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] class in the [[2011]] [[BioWare]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''. In the conversation, Doc mentions xenomedicine while discussing the Journal of Xenomedicine.<ref name="Knocks" />
